title: The Alchemist
description:
[quote]This mod is for the public version of the game. Here is the beta version: https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3780726901[/quote]

[h2]Overview[/h2]
[list]
[*] ✨ 90+ new cards
[*] 💎 9 new relics
[*] 🧪 9 new potions
[*] 📚 7 timeline epochs
[*] 🎨 Handmade art and animation [i](WIP)[/i]
[*] 🌍 Translated into 15 languages
[*] 🐸 You get to be a frog
[/list]

[h2]Playstyle[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Antitoxin[/b]: A reserve that absorbs the damage Poison would deal to you, and cures that much Poison in the process. It persists across turns, up to a limit.
[*] [b]Absorbing Pays Off[/b]: Taking Poison damage is not just a cost. Several cards reward it, turning the Poison you absorb into Strength, Block, Energy or damage.
[*] [b]Infuse[/b]: Infusing a card Enchants it for the rest of combat based on its type. Attacks apply Poison, Skills generate Antitoxin, Powers give Strength, and other cards gain Ethereal.
[*] [b]Ferment[/b]: These effects grow in potency for every turn the card stays in your hand. Playing the card transforms it into a Toxic.
[*] [b]Brew[/b]: This Rest Site option allows you to procure one of 6 unique potions that can only be obtained this way.
[*] [b][i]Sell Potions![/i][/b]: Due to the quality of these brews, the Merchant is willing to buy them from you for Gold.
[/list]


[h2]Disclaimer[/h2]
The Alchemist has been lovingly crafted to feel like a natural addition to the game. Every card, relic, and potion has been (and will continue to be) balanced against the existing game. The same care extends to flavor and lore: this character's story is woven directly into the game's existing timeline, and observant players will find more than a few threads connecting them to the world.

This mod is still in it's early stages and content is subject to change, but feedback is welcome! The best place to discuss the mod is official Slay the Spire Discord server in the #modding-forum.
